title: Rounding Off to the Nearest 5, 10, 100 and 1 000
seo_title: Grade 5 Rounding Off Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Round off to the nearest 5, 10, 100 and 1 000.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 5 rounding off worksheets: round to the nearest 5, 10, 100 and 1 000 and rounding problems. 100 questions with memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • To round off, find the two multiples the number lies between and choose the nearer one.
  • Nearest 5: 37 is between 35 and 40, nearer to 35.
  • Look at the digit to the right of the rounding place: 5 or more, round up; less than 5, round down.
  • Round off to estimate quickly.

Examples

Example

Round 48 362 to the nearest 1 000

between 48 000 and 49 000

hundreds digit 3

Answer: 48 000

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Rounding 5 down5 or more rounds up.
The wrong digitLook one place to the right.
Nearest 10 for nearest 5Multiples of 5 end in 0 or 5.

faq.q: What does CAPS Grade 5 say about rounding?
faq.a: Round off to the nearest 5, 10, 100 and 1 000.
It is handy for money and time, like R5 coins and 5-minute marks.

faq.q: Is rounding the same as estimating?
faq.a: Rounding is one way to estimate.

items.q: Which number rounds to 250 000 when you round to the nearest 10 000?
items.e: Numbers from 245 000 to 254 999 round to 250 000. 246 300 is in that range. 255 000 rounds to 260 000.

items.q: Which number rounds to 700 000 when you round to the nearest 100 000?
items.e: Numbers from 650 000 to 749 999 round to 700 000. 658 000 is in that range. 750 000 rounds to 800 000.

items.q: Which number rounds to 40 000 when you round to the nearest 1 000?
items.e: Numbers from 39 500 to 40 499 round to 40 000. 39 620 is in that range. 40 500 rounds to 41 000.

items.q: Which number rounds to 100 000 when you round to the nearest 10 000?
items.e: Numbers from 95 000 to 104 999 round to 100 000. 96 500 is in that range. 105 000 rounds to 110 000.

items.q: What is the smallest whole number that rounds to 300 000 when you round to the nearest 100 000?
items.e: Numbers from 250 000 to 349 999 round to 300 000. 249 999 has 4 ten thousands, so it rounds down to 200 000. The smallest is 250 000.

items.q: What is the greatest whole number that rounds to 80 000 when you round to the nearest 10 000?
items.e: Numbers from 75 000 to 84 999 round to 80 000. 85 000 is exactly halfway, so it rounds up to 90 000. The greatest is 84 999.

items.q: What is the smallest whole number that rounds to 63 700 when you round to the nearest 100?
items.e: Numbers from 63 650 to 63 749 round to 63 700. 63 649 has 4 tens, so it rounds down to 63 600. The smallest is 63 650.

items.q: Round 645 380 to the nearest 10 000 and to the nearest 100 000. Which pair is correct?
items.e: Always round the number you started with, 645 380. Nearest 10 000: the thousands digit is 5, so 650 000. Nearest 100 000: the ten thousands digit is 4, so 600 000. Do not round 650 000 again to get 700 000.

items.q: Which number rounds to 386 000 to the nearest 1 000 and to 390 000 to the nearest 10 000?
items.e: Numbers from 385 500 to 386 499 round to 386 000. Only 385 740 is in that range, and it rounds to 390 000 because its thousands digit is 5. 386 600 rounds to 387 000.

items.q: Estimate 48 750 + 31 260 by rounding each number to the nearest 1 000.
items.e: 48 750 rounds to 49 000 and 31 260 rounds to 31 000. 49 000 + 31 000 = 80 000. (The exact answer is 80 010, so the estimate is close.)
